svg.text: autoresearch: two loops through four layers

The outer loop runs left to right, one round after another; the shaded inner loop runs once per experiment, several at a time. Red borders: points that can refuse. Generated from architecture.json; archdraw.py check keeps it in step with the code.
inner loop: once per experiment, several in parallel (GPU slots)
